data.title: Dashen Bank and ShebaMiles Launch Platinum Co-Branded Mastercard Debit Card to Unlock Premium Travel Benefits for Customers in Ethiopia
data.description: Dashen Bank and ShebaMiles have partnered to introduce a new Platinum co-branded Mastercard Debit card in Ethiopia, offering premium travel perks to customers. This collaboration aims to enhance user experience with exclusive benefits and services. The card is designed to provide a high level of convenience and security for transactions. Customers can now access a range of privileges tailored for travel enthusiasts.

data.title: eClinicalWorks and healow Announce Record Revenues Exceeding $1.3 Billion for 2026, Driven by Accelerating AI Adoption
data.description: At the annual 2026 eClinicalWorks and healow National Conference in Nashville, Tennessee, significant financial milestones were announced. eClinicalWorks®, a prominent healthcare technology company in the US, along with healow®, a top provider of patient engagement and AI-driven healthcare solutions, are projected to achieve revenues surpassing $1.3 billion for the year. eClinicalWorks remains dedicated to advancing cloud-based electronic health records (EHR), revenue cycle management (RCM), population health, and various other healthcare technologies.

data.title: Insurity Showcases the Next Generation of Intelligent Insurance Software at Largest Excellence in AI & Insurance Conference Yet
data.description: Insurity, a top provider of cloud-based insurance software, recently held its biggest Excellence in AI & Insurance conference yet in Fort Lauderdale, Florida from October 5-7. The event showcased the latest advancements in intelligent insurance technology and their impact on transforming insurer operations and growth. Attended by insurance executives, tech experts, and industry professionals, the conference highlighted the potential of next-generation technology in reshaping the insurance sector.

data.title: SCG Appoints NetSuite AI Pioneer Tim Dietrich as First Head of AI
data.description: In Los Angeles, SCG (SaaS Consulting Group) revealed the hiring of Tim Dietrich as its inaugural Head of AI, marking a significant step towards integrating artificial intelligence into the company's operations. Serving over 280 mid-market and private equity-supported firms, SCG aims to leverage Dietrich's proficiency in NetSuite data architecture and SuiteQL in this global role. Dietrich's appointment underscores SCG's commitment to prioritizing AI in its strategies, solutions, and services, solidifying its position as an industry leader.
